The next repair must enforce the same preregistered 1.01 budget during the functional fitting recurrence, remain exactly inactive in its safe regime, and fall back to the finite weight recipe if functional fitting is undefined.
The generic MFU preflight must also reject any nonfinite logged train/evaluation loss so performance qualification cannot mask scientific instability.
